problem:
Given that the discrete random variable $Y$ has the probability mass function $f(y)$ (as shown in the table below) and the cumulative distribution function $F(y),$ compute $F(3).$

| $y$ | $0$ | $2$ | $4$ | $6$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $f(y)$ | $0.20$ | $0.25$ | $0.25$ | $0.30$ |

$F(3)=$
{{field-1}}
worked_solution:
The cumulative distribution function of a discrete random variable $Y$ is a function $F(y)$ such that

$$
F(y)=P(Y\le y).
$$

So, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}F(3) & =P(Y\le 3) \\  & =P(Y\in {0,2}) \\  & =P(Y=0)+P(Y=2) \\  & =f(0)+f(2) \\  & =0.20+0.25 \\  & =0.45.\end{aligned}
$$
